manifestations.invariant: A late timesheet import leaves the closed pay period immutable and creates one reversal and one repost in the next open cycle; a failed import restores the ledger to its pre-import state.

contract_bindings.quote: A payroll cutoff is a final boundary: the pay-run splitter keeps a closed period immutable and directs adjustments to the next open cycle.
This retro-adjustment test expects a valid late sheet to create a reversal and a repost for the next cycle.
